purpose: Complete a private reusable benchmark data resource and JCIM Application Note candidate manuscript; no new-algorithm superiority claim.
historical_runs: Reuse SAR IC50 predictions and completed P0. No rerun of old matrix or P0. No restoration of old sealed outcomes.

ki_source.cache_scope: Same Final assay/compound keys only, author per-target caches, not new activity sources.
ki_source.precheck: 66 provisional sentinel tasks / 52 groups / 41 targets / 3479 edges; numeric qualification pending.
ki_source.exposure: IDs, structures, metadata and published aggregates known; no Ki individual potency used for strategy development.
ki_source.metadata: ChEMBL37, distinct from author ChEMBL32 activity snapshot
ki_source.separation: Whole-group exclusion for any overlap with all exposed IC50 assay IDs, raw/canonical compound identities, normalized structures, DOI or document IDs.

qualification.values: Exact, finite pChEMBL, Ki/nM provenance verified from author SQL/cache fields; no unsupported censoring interpretation.
qualification.conflict: Decimal numeric identity; exclude conflicted canonical assay-compound key and incident edges, no averaging or effect filtering.
qualification.groups: Preserve pre-numeric provenance components; never split components after outcome qualification.
qualification.threshold_interpretation: Bounded operational criterion, not power guarantee or journal standard.
qualification.sentinel_roles: Preserve identity-precheck assignments, delete ineligible entities/edges only; no reallocation.

fixed_c8.c8: Original deterministic structural max-min on qualified participants, first minimum ID; original edges outside C8.

acquisition_sentinel.predictor: P0 fixed Tanimoto residual predictor unchanged
acquisition_sentinel.other_policies: Complete descriptive benchmarks; no KG superiority hypothesis

locked_parameters.interpretation: Preserve original implementation scaling and serialized preprocessors; do not re-estimate Ki global parameters.

statistics.aggregation: tasks equal within final group, groups equal
statistics.sampling: Common paired resampling multiplicities over union of final groups; normalize each track on its represented groups. Family remains size2 if one track not run.
statistics.scope: Conditional on frozen fitted models/policies, not total training or research selection uncertainty.

freeze_sequence: Freeze qualification, predictors, acquisition, statistics and complete budget with code hashes before Ki numeric access
Run value qualification, expose only count/manifests; record label access
Run task-isolated predictions/acquisitions; source values and allowed references only
Uniformly score query outcomes and report all results

budget.reserve: Reserve whole remaining matrix plus scoring before starting; old ledger unchanged

stop_or_shrink.insufficient_groups: No formal result for that track, no rule relaxation or new source search; finish resource and honest draft
stop_or_shrink.resource_overlap_or_no_independent_reuse: State concrete contribution shortfall, do not declare submission-ready or add model search

publication: No public release, submission or third-party contact in this stage. Private release candidate only.
deliverables: word counts under both current official definitions

implementation.candidate_fixed_track: All precheck non-overlapping groups, original edges after numeric qualification; >=20 participants
implementation.candidate_acquisition_track: Only precheck identity_sentinel_eligible=True tasks with preserved assignments
implementation.P0_changes: Only API extraction, oracle logging and predictions at every budget4..8. Formulas/initialization/ties/random task hashing unchanged.
implementation.bootstrap_implementation: NumPy default_rng(20261104).multinomial(G,1/G,5000) over sorted union groups; track-restricted normalization.
implementation.input_handling: Numeric eligibility reads Final and matching cache keys. Output values remain separate from count report. Task predictor only source/pool inputs; query files first loaded by scoring.
implementation.sql_proof: UPSTREAM_CODE_ONLY.py.txt gather_data: standard_type Ki, standard_units nM, standard_relation =, non-null pChEMBL, validity_comment null. Cached export omits type/units/relation; qualification relies on explicit code/source lineage plus Decimal same-key agreement.

new_budget_preflight_rule: 3 operations per fixed task + at most74 per acquisition task +100 reserved engineering operations <=25000. All scores and5000 paired draws reserved before any predictor. All CPU stages aggregate under8h.

previous_budgets_preserved.strict_scaffold: Qualification passed; frozen-budget preflight blocked; no fitted predictor or score
